## Context

What problem does this change solve?

## Decision

What changed, and which alternatives were rejected?

## Consequences

Describe security, privacy, persistence, recovery, provider-compatibility, and operator-workflow effects.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Type checking passes.
- [ ] Manual evidence is included where automation is insufficient.
- [ ] No secrets, personal paths, customer data, generated packages, or local configuration are included.
- [ ] Product and security claims match implemented behavior.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or boundaries changed.
- [ ] Changes do not implicitly commit, push, release, deploy, pay, or message externally.
